en: The postcard features a monochrome photograph of a classical European cityscape with prominent, ornate 19th-century buildings surrounding a tree-lined public square or esplanade. Visible signage on one building reads 'SUNDSVALLS SPARBANK.' The street is labeled with 'Sundsvall' and 'Esplanaden' in red text. The reverse side lists address fields and a Swedish postage stamp with the word 'SVERIGE.'
